style.name: Jack & Diane house style
style.summary: Hand-drawn 2D Korean webtoon / anime animation. Warm, muted beige and earthy colour palette. Consistent faces and body proportions. Expressive, cinematic acting. Not 3D, not Pixar-style, not photorealistic.
style.promptBlock: Hand-drawn 2D Korean webtoon / anime animation, cel-shaded, soft ink linework, warm muted beige and earthy palette, consistent character faces and body proportions, expressive cinematic acting, vertical 9:16 framing. NOT 3D, NOT Pixar-style, NOT photorealistic.
style.negativePrompt: 3D render, Pixar style, CGI, photorealistic, glossy plastic skin, neon colors, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed face, off-model character

characters.name: Diane

personality: obsessed with discovering products on Coupang
